hooks.name: poltergeist-check-spec
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, run Poltergeist's adversarial tests against the running app and fix what fails.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Check the running app against {{SPEC}} with the Poltergeist MCP tools. If the app is not running on the target in poltergeist.config.json, say so and stop. Otherwise call summon_ghosts for that spec, then read the board with get_haunting_report. For each failing criterion, read its section of the report, fix the code (never edit requirements.md, design.md or tasks.md), and confirm the fix with rehaunt for that criterion id. Stop when every criterion passes or a fix needs a decision from the user.
